title: Deterministic directory manifest
prompt: Build a CLI reading one JSON object {root,exclude} from stdin, where root is an absolute path of an existing directory and exclude is an array of patterns. Walk root recursively and list every regular file with its size in bytes. Never follow symbolic links or junctions: links of any kind are neither listed nor descended into. Empty directories produce nothing. Paths are relative to root, use "/" as the separator and are sorted in plain code-unit string order. A pattern containing no "/" excludes every file or directory with exactly that name at any depth (excluding a directory excludes everything below it); a pattern containing "/" is anchored at root and excludes the file or directory at exactly that relative path and everything below it. Patterns must be nonempty strings without backslashes, without a leading or trailing "/" and without "." or ".." or empty segments, otherwise (and for a root that is not an existing directory, or invalid input JSON) exit nonzero, leave stdout empty and write a diagnostic to stderr. Print exactly one JSON object and a newline: {files} where files is an array of {path,size}. Exit 0 on success. Names may contain spaces and non-ASCII characters. Never modify anything. No external services are needed.
